description: This file defines the ConfigSchemaChecker class, which listens to configuration save events in Drupal and validates the configuration schema, throwing exceptions if invalid.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaChecker
classes.description: A class that listens to configuration save events and validates configuration schemas in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for ConfigSchemaChecker, initializes with a typed config manager, optional exclusions, and a flag for constraint validation.

methods.name: onConfigSave
methods.description: Handles the config save event, validates the configuration against its schema, and throws exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this class subscribes to, specifically the config save event.
